origin.description: The file starts with the UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel reads it as UTF-8.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: The file starts with the UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel reads it as UTF-8.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
path <- tempfile()
write_excel_csv(data.frame(a = 1), path)
raw <- readBin(path, "raw", file.info(path)$size)
paste(paste(as.integer(raw[1:3]), collapse = ","), rawToChar(raw[4:length(raw)]), sep = "|")

translation.description: The file starts with the UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel reads it as UTF-8.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: The file starts with the UTF-8 byte order mark so Excel reads it as UTF-8.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
path = tempfile.mktemp()
write_excel_csv(frame(["a"], [[1.0]]), path)
raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
return ",".join(str(value) for value in raw[:3]) + "|" + raw[3:].decode()
